title: Guarding Against Physical Attacks: The Xbox One Story — Tony Chen, Microsoft
summary: Microsoft's Tony Chen explains how the Xbox One was designed to resist physical attacks, including secure boot, encrypted memory, a security processor and a hypervisor. The goal was to make any hardware attack cost more than the price of many games.
why: HN points to it constantly in console, DRM and hardware-security threads as the authoritative account of Xbox One's threat model.

quote.text: This is a very interesting talk from Microsoft about how they made Xbox immune to physical attacks
